name: CANE_HAULING_AHEAD_FLAG_YELLOW_LONG
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q07 'Cane hauling ahead' warning flag (1995/2016, rev B): a 1100 x 900 reflectorised PVC-coated nylon flag, black letters on yellow ground (note 2), fully dimensioned (no size table, one size), no border, square corners. Legend three lines 140DM (Series D, cap 140; DM read as the plain series as on the other QLD sheets), chain 120 / 140 / 120 / 140 / 120 / 140 / 120 = 900: cap tops 120, 380, 640, each line centred on the flag's centreline. The sheet's dashed rod-pocket lines (50 from the top and bottom edges), the two 100 dia wind-relief holes on the centreline and the support hardware are construction details of the flag, not legend, and are not drawn. Black on yellow.
